name: cmi-evidence-surface-v2-upgrade-simulation
purpose: Test-only dual-version upgrade fixture. It proves versioning mechanics without declaring Evidence Contract v2 as a supported runtime contract.

additiveProbe.meaning: Synthetic test-only field used to prove that a v2 consumer can require an added field while a retained v1 consumer continues projecting only v1 fields.

breakingChange.meaning: Synthetic test-only semantic replacement used to prove that a breaking evidence meaning cannot be advertised as v1 and is permitted only inside the explicit v2 simulation while v1 replay remains retained.

guardrails: This fixture is not a runtime negotiation surface and must never be treated as evidence that Evidence Contract v2 is released or supported.
The released v1 fixture and v1 golden corpus remain unchanged and independently replayable.
A breaking semantic change must not pass as contract version 1.
A simulated contract upgrade must retain prior-version regression coverage.
The synthetic v2CompatibilityProbe field has no product semantics outside this test fixture.
